name: Even PTT Reader Simulator
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'nohup npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/even-ptt-vite.log 2>&1 & sleep 5; nohup npm run sim:headless >/tmp/even-ptt-simulator.log 2>&1 &'
postAttachCommand: >/dev/null; then nohup npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/even-ptt-vite.log 2>&1 & fi; sleep 3; if ! pgrep -f
>/dev/null; then nohup npm run sim:headless >/tmp/even-ptt-simulator.log 2>&1 & fi'
